title: Botulinum Toxin Injections for Chronic Migraine and Cervical Dystonia
jurisdiction: CMS Hospital Outpatient Prior Authorization (42 CFR § 419.80)
description: CMS prior authorization for onabotulinumtoxinA injections for chronic migraine or cervical dystonia. Requires documented headache frequency >= 15 days per month for >= 3 months, each lasting 4+ hours, with failure or intolerance of at least two classes of oral migraine preventive medications.

change_log.author: CMS MCD
change_log.summary: OPD Prior Authorization clinical guidelines update.

criteria.name: Chronic Migraine Frequency (>= 15 Days/Month)
criteria.description: Documented headache frequency >= 15 days per month for >= 3 months, of which >= 8 days meet criteria for typical migraine attacks.
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

criteria.name: Oral Prophylactic Medication Trial Failure (>= 2 Classes)
criteria.description: Documented inadequate response, contraindication, or intolerable side effects to adequate trials of >= 2 classes of conventional oral migraine preventives (e.g. beta-blockers, anticonvulsants, antidepressants).
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

criteria.name: Episodic Migraine Exclusion
criteria.description: Patient experiencing episodic migraine (< 15 headache days per month) or simple tension headache.
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

cms_reference.notes: MCD document at L33942 governs Physical Therapy - Home Health, whereas policy subject is Botulinum Toxin Injections. Flagged as needing realignment.
